title: What Makes HFTs Tick? Tick Size Changes and Information Advantage in a Market with Fast and Slow Traders
authors: Alain Chaboud; Avery Dao; Clara Vega; Filip Žikeš
eligible_reason: Event studies around two market-wide EBS tick-size changes (decrease 7 Mar 2011, increase 24 Sep 2012) for EUR/USD and USD/JPY: before/after means and a spot-vs-futures DiD (reg y treated after did, optionally + implied vol + trend) in a 60-day window. Common event dates per change, pooled treated dummy, no unit FE; logits for Tables 8-9.
design_notes: Stata and Python. Units are two currency pairs x spot/futures markets; daily data.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: spot vs futures DiD at a single event date; pooled treated dummy; some columns add implied volatility and a linear trend

data_files_note: ReadMe.docx: EBS and Thomson Reuters Tick History data are proprietary; the package provides fake data sets with the documented variables.
data_provenance_note: README states the shipped datasets are fake.
